scope: Prepared exact-package fallback for the Windows NSIS build prerequisite only

trigger.observed_failure: All three official requests returned HTTP 200 HTML download pages; retained payload hashes and HTML bytes were independently checked. No payload passed the unchanged installer pin.

prepared_fallback.maximum_bytes_explanation: Exact expected size plus one sentinel byte; exceeding the expected size fails before ZIP parsing
prepared_fallback.package_gate: HTTP 200, exact package length and package SHA256 before ZIP access
prepared_fallback.archive_gate: At most 32 entries; exactly one case-insensitive match with exact target spelling; exact entry length, bounded compressed length and regular/unspecified file type
prepared_fallback.extraction: Only the known entry stream is copied to a fixed evidence filename under an exact byte bound; no broad extraction or package script execution
prepared_fallback.execution_gate: Unchanged inner installer SHA256 and executable-header check, followed by the existing copied-installer hash check immediately before execution
prepared_fallback.retained_evidence: Package payload/headers/status/final URL, entry payload, hashes, byte counts, timestamps and failures
